main_body: Open bookshelf/scroll shelf cabinet, a wooden frame with dark maroon back cavities holding scrolls, books and small items, seen face-on
top_band: light tan, rows 1-3 (about 2-3 rows), only a thin cap above the orange frame; no deeper horizontal surface
evidence: Reading a column down the middle: rows 1-3 are a light tan cap, then an orange frame and a flat dark maroon back panel from about row 4 down to row 28. The shelf boards are 1-2 row orange bands seen edge-on, so no shelf surface is visible from above. There is no distinct front-edge line and no dark eave shadow under the cap. The compartments are painted as flat dark panels with no inset edges or inner shadows. This reads as a flat front elevation with a thin cap, like the red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only' guide cases.

style.evidence: The wood has only about 3 steps (light tan, orange, dark brown). The large maroon cavities are flat fills with no grain or speckle. The scroll and book props are small, simple blocks of 2-4 colours. The frame has no wood grain, no per-plank highlights and no varied shading. Compared with the stall and well references, it is flatter and carries far less information per tile.
